# Krometrail

> Rust foundations for local browser control and temporal visual evidence for coding agents.

## Current state

The current executable exposes `--version`, `--help`, `doctor`, and `mcp`. `doctor` discovers local browser installations without launching. `mcp` exposes lifecycle, browser-control, temporal investigation, retention, browser-event, and retained artifact/source-frame resource surfaces over stdio; controlled capture and durable recording are implemented behind the same runtime.

## Contributor docs

- [Development](/guide/development): Rust build, test, lint, run, release, and docs tooling.
- [MCP configuration](/guide/mcp-configuration): configure the implemented local MCP stdio server and its browser/evidence boundary.
- [Runtime reference](/reference/runtime): current executable contract.
- [Configuration](/reference/configuration): current configuration status.
- [Documentation navigation](/agents): source-of-truth order.
